atributos.db.statement: INSERT INTO ai_frecuencias.execution_log (execution_id, tipo, estado, etapa, progreso, intentos, marca_agua_anterior, marca_agua_nueva, data_cutoff, filas_leidas, filas_validas, model_id, feature_version, umbrales_version, parametros, metricas, correlation_id, mensaje, iniciado_en, terminado_en, worker_id, lease_hasta, disponible_desde, programada_para, traceparent, ruta, padre_id, particion) VALUES (%(execution_id)s::UUID, %(tipo)s::VARCHAR, %(estado)s::VARCHAR, %(etapa)s::VARCHAR, %(progreso)s, %(intentos)s::INTEGER, %(marca_agua_anterior)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(marca_agua_nueva)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(data_cutoff)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(filas_leidas)s::INTEGER, %(filas_validas)s::INTEGER, %(model_id)s::VARCHAR, %(feature_version)s::VARCHAR, %(umbrales_version)s::INTEGER, %(parametros)s::JSONB, %(metricas)s::JSONB, %(correlation_id)s::VARCHAR, %(mensaje)s::VARCHAR, %(iniciado_en)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(terminado_en)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(worker_id)s::VARCHAR, %(lease_hasta)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(disponible_desde)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(programada_para)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(traceparent)s::VARCHAR, %(ruta)s::VARCHAR, %(padre_id)s::UUID, %(particion)s::VARCHAR) RETURNING ai_frecuencias.execution_log.creado_en, ai_frecuencias.execution_log.actualizado_en
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%(k)s)

WITH c AS (
    SELECT e.execution_id
      FROM ai_frecuencias.execution_log e
     WHERE e.estado = 'en_cola'
       AND coalesce(e.disponible_desde, now()) <= now()
       AND (CAST(%(id)s AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.execution_id = CAST(%(id)s AS uuid))
       AND (e.tipo <> 'frecuencia'
            OR (e.particion IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM ai_frecuencias.execution_log h
                   WHERE h.padre_id = e.execution_id AND h.estado IN ('en_cola', 'corriendo')))
            OR (e.particion IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM ai_frecuencias.execution_log x
                   WHERE x.tipo = 'frecuencia' AND x.particion IS NULL AND x.execution_id <> e.execution_id
                     AND (x.ruta IS NULL OR e.ruta IS NULL OR x.ruta = e.ruta)
                     AND (x.estado = 'corriendo'
                          OR (x.estado = 'en_cola' AND x.creado_en < e.creado_en
                              AND x.disponible_desde > now())))))
     ORDER BY e.creado_en, e.execution_id
     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
     LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE ai_frecuencias.execution_log t
   SET estado = 'corriendo', worker_id = %(w)s, intentos = t.intentos + 1,
       lease_hasta = now() + make_interval(secs => %(lease)s), disponible_desde = NULL,
       iniciado_en = coalesce(t.iniciado_en, now()), actualizado_en = now(),
       mensaje = 'Intento ' || (t.intentos + 1) || ' en ' || %(w)s
  FROM c
 WHERE t.execution_id = c.execution_id
RETURNING t.execution_id, t.tipo, t.intentos, t.ruta
